DDL	CREATE DATABASE mydb1
SESSION	USE mydb1
DDL	CREATE TABLE t1 USING parquet AS SELECT 1 AS i1
DDL	CREATE DATABASE mydb2
SESSION	USE mydb2
DDL	CREATE TABLE t1 USING parquet AS SELECT 20 AS i1
SESSION	USE mydb1
READ	SELECT i1 FROM t1
READ	SELECT i1 FROM mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT t1.i1 FROM t1
READ	SELECT t1.i1 FROM mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.i1 FROM t1
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.i1 FROM mydb1.t1
SESSION	USE mydb2
READ	SELECT i1 FROM t1
READ	SELECT i1 FROM mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT t1.i1 FROM t1
READ	SELECT t1.i1 FROM mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.i1 FROM mydb1.t1
SESSION	USE mydb1
READ	SELECT t1.* FROM t1
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.* FROM mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT t1.* FROM mydb1.t1
SESSION	USE mydb2
READ	SELECT t1.* FROM t1
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.* FROM mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT t1.* FROM mydb1.t1
READ	SELECT a.* FROM mydb1.t1 AS a
SESSION	USE mydb1
DDL	CREATE TABLE t3 USING parquet AS SELECT * FROM VALUES (4,1), (3,1) AS t3(c1, c2)
DDL	CREATE TABLE t4 USING parquet AS SELECT * FROM VALUES (4,1), (2,1) AS t4(c2, c3)
READ	SELECT * FROM t3 WHERE c1 IN (SELECT c2 FROM t4 WHERE t4.c3 = t3.c2)
READ	SELECT * FROM mydb1.t3 WHERE c1 IN
SESSION	SET spark.sql.crossJoin.enabled = true
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.i1 FROM t1, mydb2.t1
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.i1 FROM mydb1.t1, mydb2.t1
SESSION	USE mydb2
READ	SELECT mydb1.t1.i1 FROM t1, mydb1.t1
SESSION	SET spark.sql.crossJoin.enabled = false
SESSION	USE mydb1
DDL	CREATE TABLE t5(i1 INT, t5 STRUCT<i1:INT, i2:INT>) USING parquet
WRITE	INSERT INTO t5 VALUES(1, (2, 3))
READ	SELECT t5.i1 FROM t5
READ	SELECT t5.t5.i1 FROM t5
READ	SELECT t5.t5.i1 FROM mydb1.t5
READ	SELECT t5.i1 FROM mydb1.t5
READ	SELECT t5.* FROM mydb1.t5
READ	SELECT t5.t5.* FROM mydb1.t5
READ	SELECT mydb1.t5.t5.i1 FROM mydb1.t5
READ	SELECT mydb1.t5.t5.i2 FROM mydb1.t5
READ	SELECT mydb1.t5.* FROM mydb1.t5
READ	SELECT mydb1.t5.* FROM t5
SESSION	USE default
DDL	DROP DATABASE mydb1 CASCADE
DDL	DROP DATABASE mydb2 CASCADE
